Professional Summary
Focused Android developer with a strong track record building consumer-facing mobile applications. Experienced in designing and implementing performant, maintainable features using modern Android toolkits and collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver on product goals. Proven ability to own end-to-end delivery, improve app architecture, and integrate backend services.

Technical Skills
Kotlin, Android, Jetpack Compose, Java, Room, REST APIs, Jira, Confluence

- Collaborated on performance optimizations across the app, reducing average activity launch time by 20% and stabilizing memory usage during heavy image loads.

Android Developer, Vertex Analytics (Jul 2019 - Oct 2022)
- Re-architected analytics onboarding flow in Kotlin, leveraging Room for offline event storage and batching to REST APIs, improving event delivery reliability by 28%.
- Built and maintained core SDK components for data collection on Android, ensuring backward compatibility and reducing crash rate through structured testing and code reviews logged in Jira.
- Partnered with product and QA teams using Confluence to track feature specs and rollout plans, enabling staged releases with targeted telemetry.

- Developed customer-facing UI components with Jetpack Compose and Java for promotional campaigns, increasing featured offer engagement by 18%.
- Integrated multiple REST APIs to support dynamic content and personalized recommendations; implemented caching and fallbacks to improve perceived performance.
- Worked with design and backend teams via Jira and Confluence to iterate rapidly on experiments and feature rollouts.

Android Developer, Tata Consultancy Services (Sep 2017 - Aug 2018)
- Implemented offline-first data workflows using Room and integrated REST APIs to synchronize user data while handling conflict resolution.
- Contributed Jetpack Compose prototypes to validate new interaction patterns and reduce implementation time for UI teams.
- Participated in sprint planning and documentation in Jira and Confluence, ensuring delivery commitments and knowledge transfer.
